## Monthly median time to discovery

Method. Publish times come from the CMS ( published_at ). First visits come from our own server log and leave out any hit that fails verification against the operator's published IP ranges or reverse DNS, so fake bots never count. Pages whose URL was already being crawled before their publish date (republished or migrated pages) are excluded, so the clock only starts for pages that were genuinely new. Medians use only the pages a crawler has reached; "still waiting" counts the rest.
